coach_briefing: The route data support one shared outing despite a 37 s device-clock offset; use SpeedCoach for rate, speed, and distance. All six works and all five 240 s recoveries were reconstructed. Rate prescription was met except work 5 (19.99 SPM versus 22–24). Speed fell in the later works while conditions shifted from tailwind to strong headwind, an association rather than a causal finding. Confirm band use before judging first-block equipment compliance; prescribed-distance completion remains indeterminate.

deviations.description: Work 5 averaged 19.99 SPM, below its prescribed 22–24 SPM range.

limitations: Environmental timing supports association with observed speed changes but cannot establish causation, athlete improvement, or athlete regression.
environment_assessment.summary: Conditions shifted from tailwind to headwind: effective headwind changed from −1.0 m/s at the start to +5.5 m/s at the end, crossing sign at 1800 s. Wind speed increased from 1.0 to 5.5 m/s, gusts from 1.3 to 7.0 m/s, and crosswind reached 3.499 m/s during the shift.
